name: drive-file-renamed-to-zapier-table

deploy.description: Keep the Name (and parent) of a Google Drive file or folder current in [Table] Google Drive Files and Folders when it is updated. Source of truth: https://github.com/work-flowers/zapier-sdk/tree/main/drive-file-renamed-to-zapier-table
deploy.enable_on_publish_note: Parked at first publish so it could not double-write alongside the then-live classic Zap. Cutover done 2026-08-22; kept as the record of why v1 shipped disabled. A republish carries the CURRENT enabled state forward (read off Zapier), so this no longer affects anything.

trigger.trigger_note: Google Drive POLLING trigger on updated files, unscoped (no `drive`/`folder`), same as the classic Zap. `include_deleted` is BOOLEAN per `list-trigger-input-fields`, so the classic Zap's "no" is a real false here. Durable triggers have no polling-interval field, so it polls at the account default — matching the classic Zap's polling_interval_override of 0. No external URL to cut over.

connections_note: None needed. The workflow only touches Zapier Tables, which require no connection; the Google Drive connection is bound to the TRIGGER (trigger.authentication_id), not to a step.

tables.01K5ZN0AGNDHS4C424XEDCWJZY: [Table] Google Drive Files and Folders — f3 Name and f4 Parent ID updated here; rows are CREATED by drive-files-to-zapier-table, never by this workflow.

replaces_classic_zap: Update Google Drive File Names in Zapier Table

cutover.classic_zap_disabled: 2026-08-22 — confirmed by Dennis. Not machine-verifiable: classic Zaps are exposed by neither the SDK CLI nor the MCP connector.
cutover.status: complete — this durable is the only thing keeping Name/Parent ID current in [Table] Google Drive Files and Folders.

behaviour_changes: The classic Zap folded "name differs" into its Table search filter with success-on-miss OFF, so every update to a file whose name had NOT changed — and every update to a file the inventory had never logged — failed the step and surfaced as a Zap error. The durable looks the row up by Drive id only, compares in code, and skips quietly (`already-current` / `not-in-inventory`).
A parent change is now mirrored too (f4 Parent ID), so a file moved between folders no longer leaves a stale parent behind.
description: Google Drive polling trigger (updated file) -> keep that object's Name and Parent ID current in [Table] Google Drive Files and Folders. Skips quietly when nothing changed or the object was never inventoried.
